title: The Essential Commodities Act, 1955
full_text: The Essential Commodities Act, 1955 null Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 195510 Act Number: 10 Enactment Date: 1955-04-01 Act Year: 1955 Short Title: The Essential Commodities Act, 1955 Long Title: An Act to provide, in the interest of the general public, for the control of the production, supply and distribution of, and trade and commerce, in certain commodities. Department: Department of AGRICULTURE DEVELOPMENT AND FARMER WELFARE AND BIO-TECHNOLOGY Enforcement Date: 01-04-1955 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Department of Consumer Affairs) Location: Chhattisgarh Ref Act ID: 195510 Schedule 1.
